h: Funke Akindele opens up on life behind the camera despite her "minister of happiness" image
p: Funke Akindele has spoken about the private side of her life, saying she sometimes cries off-stage despite her cheerful public image.
more: She has also been trending this week over a moment with MC Oluomo at an event.
